component.name: litellm
component.description: TAPPaaS module litellm: triage of its own critical/high CVEs (#788).

analysis.detail: Debian/Ubuntu packaging bug (Lua loaded as a dynamic library, exposing package/loadlib); nixpkgs builds redis with its bundled Lua, and litellm's redis listens on 127.0.0.1 only.
Concerns an unofficial Windows port (dbghelp.dll search path); upstream Redis on Linux is not affected.

Jinja rendering in fsspec's ReferenceFileSystem (Kerchunk reference JSON); fsspec is in the image only for huggingface_hub and polars, nothing in litellm opens a reference:// filesystem, and no request can supply one.

libsndfile bundled in the soundfile wheel (bundled-library scan, #811). LiteLLM reads audio with it only on transcription requests (duration for cost, the NVIDIA Riva provider). Reachable only by holders of a LiteLLM key; no transcription model is configured and Open WebUI's speech-to-text runs in the browser.

ratings.justification: risk in this deployment, from the triage

analysis.detail: OpenSSL linked statically into the cryptography wheel, found by the bundled-library scan (#811). The image has no pyOpenSSL, so nothing runs TLS, DTLS or QUIC through this copy; Python's ssl module uses the interpreter's own OpenSSL, which the OS-package scan reports. This is a TLS/DTLS/QUIC/CMP/OCSP/DANE code path.
